(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 DERIVATIVES, DYNAMIC EMISSIVITY & GOERTZEL ULTRASONIC RESONANCE FILTER               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Instantaneous heating rate dT/dt [deg C/s] *)

rPrevVotedTemp_DegC := rVotedJointTemp_DegC;

(* Instantaneous collapse rate dz/dt [nm/s] *)
rDynamicSolderCollapseRate_nm_s := (rVotedZPosition_nm - rPrevVotedPos_nm) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevVotedPos_nm := rVotedZPosition_nm;

(* Dynamic Pyrometer Emissivity Compensation: Solder phase changes reflectance *)
IF rVotedJointTemp_DegC > c_rSAC305MeltingPoint_DegC THEN
    (* Molten solder mirror-like wetting increases reflectance to ~68% *)
    rApparentReflectance_Pct := 68.0;
    rEmissivityCorrectionFactor := 0.72; (* Effective emissivity drops *)
ELSE
    (* Solid rough micro-bump top surface reflectance ~32% *)
    rApparentReflectance_Pct := 32.0;
    rEmissivityCorrectionFactor := 0.92;
END_IF;

(* GOERTZEL DISCRETE FOURIER TRANSFORM AT 68.5 kHz RESONANT FREQUENCY *)
(* Difference equation: s[n] = x[n] + coeff * s[n-1] - s[n-2] *)
rGoertzel_s0 := rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV + (c_rGoertzelCoeff * rGoertzel_s1) - rGoertzel_s2;
rGoertzel_s2 := rGoertzel_s1;
rGoertzel_s1 := rGoertzel_s0;
iGoertzel_SampleCount := iGoertzel_SampleCount + 1;

(* Compute block power every 10 samples (1.0 ms window at 10 kHz sub-frame) *)
IF iGoertzel_SampleCount >= 10 THEN
    rGoertzel_Real := rGoertzel_s1 - (rGoertzel_s2 * COS(c_rGoertzelOmega));
    rGoertzel_Imag := rGoertzel_s2 * SIN(c_rGoertzelOmega);
    rGoertzel_Mag := SQRT((rGoertzel_Real * rGoertzel_Real) + (rGoertzel_Imag * rGoertzel_Imag)) * 0.10;
    
    (* Dynamic acoustic impedance estimate: Z = V_acoustic / I_piezo *)
    IF rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent > 1.0 THEN
        rUltrasonicAcousticImpedance_Ohms := (rGoertzel_Mag * 10.0) / (rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent * 0.15);
    ELSE
        rUltrasonicAcousticImpedance_Ohms := 450.0; (* Nominal quiescent impedance *)
    END_IF;
    
    (* Acoustic Damping Loss Factor: ratio of active attenuation vs solid baseline *)
    IF rBaselineAcousticMag > 10.0 THEN
        rAcousticDampingLossFactor := (rBaselineAcousticMag - rGoertzel_Mag) / rBaselineAcousticMag;
        IF rAcousticDampingLossFactor < 0.0 THEN rAcousticDampingLossFactor := 0.0; END_IF;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Detect Solder Liquefaction & Wetting Drop *)
    IF (rVotedJointTemp_DegC >= (c_rSAC305MeltingPoint_DegC - 2.0)) AND (rAcousticDampingLossFactor > 0.45) THEN
        bSolderLiquefactionTriggered := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Reset Goertzel delay buffers *)
    rGoertzel_s0 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s1 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s2 := 0.0;
    iGoertzel_SampleCount := 0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 INTERMETALLIC COMPOUND (IMC) ARRHENIUS KINETICS & QUALITY INDEX FUSION                *)
(* Reaction: Cu + Sn -> Cu6Sn5 (eta-phase) and Cu3Sn (epsilon-phase)                        *)
(* Growth equation: d(delta^2)/dt = 2 * K0 * exp(-Q/(R*T)) * (1 + chi * P_us)             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF rVotedJointTemp_DegC > 180.0 THEN
    (* Absolute thermodynamic temperature in Kelvin *)
    rTmpA := rVotedJointTemp_DegC + 273.15;
    
    (* Arrhenius exponential factor exp(-Q / (R * T)) *)
    rTmpB := EXP(-1.0 * c_rArrheniusActivationEnergy / (c_rGasConstant_R * rTmpA));
    
    (* Ultrasonic non-thermal acoustic cavitation & streaming enhancement multiplier *)
    IF bUltrasonicEmissionActive THEN
        rUltrasonicKineticEnhancement := 1.0 + (0.015 * rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent);
    ELSE
        rUltrasonicKineticEnhancement := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Instantaneous rate in nm^2 / second (1 m^2/s = 1E18 nm^2/s) *)
    rInstantaneousIMCRate_nm2_s := 2.0 * (c_rArrheniusPreFactor * 1.0E18) * rTmpB * rUltrasonicKineticEnhancement;
    
    (* Discrete trapezoidal Euler integration *)
    rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2 := rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2 + (rInstantaneousIMCRate_nm2_s * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
    rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm := SQRT(rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2);
END_IF;

(* Online Bondline Thickness BLT Measurement from Touchdown Datum *)
IF bTouchDownDetected THEN
    rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm := rTargetBondlineThickness_nm - (rVotedZPosition_nm - rTouchDownPosLatch_nm);
    IF rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm < 100.0 THEN
        rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm := 100.0; (* Physical silicon contact hardstop *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm := rTargetBondlineThickness_nm;
END_IF;

(* In-Situ Multi-Physics Bond Quality Index (BQI) Fusion *)
(* Parameters: 1) IMC thickness in 350-850 nm window; 2) BLT within +/- 1500 nm; 3) Tilt < 15 urad *)
rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := 0.0;
IF (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm >= 350.0) AND (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm <= 850.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.40; (* IMC optimal weight 40% *)
ELSIF (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm >= 200.0) AND (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm <= 1200.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.25;
ELSE
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.05;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm - rTargetBondlineThickness_nm) <= 1000.0 THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.35; (* BLT precision weight 35% *)
ELSIF ABS(rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm - rTargetBondlineThickness_nm) <= 2500.0 THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.20;
ELSE
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.05;
END_IF;

IF (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad) <= 15.0) AND (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad) <= 15.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.25; (* Tilt co-planarity weight 25% *)
ELSIF (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad) <= 35.0) AND (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad) <= 35.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.15;
END_IF;
rBondQualityIndex := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 CYBER-PHYSICAL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (LUENBERGER ESTIMATOR)                            *)
(* Equation: x_hat[k] = A * x_hat[k-1] + B * u[k-1] + L * (y[k] - y_hat[k])                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.1 Measurement vector y_meas assembly *)
vecY_Meas[1] := rVotedBondForce_N;
vecY_Meas[2] := rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm;
vecY_Meas[3] := rVotedJointTemp_DegC;
vecY_Meas[4] := rUltrasonicAcousticImpedance_Ohms;

(* 5.2 Prior state prediction: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTmpA := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matA[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * vecX_Hat[iLoopJ]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matB[iLoopI, iLoopK] * vecU_Prev[iLoopK]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_Pred[iLoopI] := rTmpA;
END_FOR;

(* 5.3 Predicted output: y_hat = C * x_pred + D * u *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTmpA := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matC[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * vecX_Pred[iLoopJ]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matD[iLoopI, iLoopK] * vecU_Prev[iLoopK]);
    END_FOR;
    vecY_Hat[iLoopI] := rTmpA;
    vecY_Err[iLoopI] := vecY_Meas[iLoopI] - vecY_Hat[iLoopI];
END_FOR;

(* 5.4 Posterior state correction: x_hat = x_pred + L * e *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTmpA := vecX_Pred[iLoopI];
    FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matL[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * vecY_Err[iLoopJ]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_Hat[iLoopI] := rTmpA;
END_FOR;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) FAST PROJECTED GRADIENT SOLVER             *)
(* Quadratic cost functional: J = sum(||y - r||^2_Q + ||delta_u||^2_R)                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.1 Populate reference preview horizon vectors (Np = 5) *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 5 DO
    vecRefTrajectory_Force[iLoopI] := rTraj_TargetForce_N;
    vecRefTrajectory_BLT[iLoopI] := rTargetBondlineThickness_nm;
    vecRefTrajectory_Temp[iLoopI] := rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC;
END_FOR;

(* 6.2 Iterative Projected Gradient Descent on delta_u *)
(* Gradient calculation for control vector u = [VoiceCoilCurrent, LaserPower, UltrasonicPower] *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO iMPC_MaxIterations DO
    (* Output errors evaluated at current step *)
    rTmpA := (vecX_Hat[3] - vecRefTrajectory_Force[1]); (* Force error *)
    rTmpB := (vecX_Hat[6] - vecRefTrajectory_BLT[1]);   (* BLT error *)
    rTmpC := (vecX_Hat[5] - vecRefTrajectory_Temp[1]);  (* Temp error *)
    
    (* Analytical gradient w.r.t control inputs *)
    rGrad1 := (matQ_Weight[1] * rTmpA * matB[3,1]) + (matQ_Weight[2] * rTmpB * matB[6,1]) + (matR_Weight[1] * vecDeltaU[1]);
    rGrad2 := (matQ_Weight[3] * rTmpC * matB[5,2]) + (matQ_Weight[2] * rTmpB * matB[6,2]) + (matR_Weight[2] * vecDeltaU[2]);
    rGrad3 := (matQ_Weight[1] * rTmpA * matB[3,3]) + (matQ_Weight[3] * rTmpC * matB[5,3]) + (matR_Weight[3] * vecDeltaU[3]);
    
    (* Gradient step *)
    vecDeltaU[1] := vecDeltaU[1] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * rGrad1);
    vecDeltaU[2] := vecDeltaU[2] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * rGrad2);
    vecDeltaU[3] := vecDeltaU[3] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * rGrad3);
    
    (* Slew rate bounding projection *)
    IF vecDeltaU[1] > 2.50 THEN vecDeltaU[1] := 2.50; ELSIF vecDeltaU[1] <-2.50 THEN vecDeltaU[1] :=-2.50; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[2] > 25.0 THEN vecDeltaU[2] := 25.0; ELSIF vecDeltaU[2] <-25.0 THEN vecDeltaU[2] :=-25.0; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[3] > 5.00 THEN vecDeltaU[3] := 5.00; ELSIF vecDeltaU[3] <-5.00 THEN vecDeltaU[3] :=-5.00; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* 6.3 Integrate control increments: u[k] = u[k-1] + delta_u[k] *)
vecU_Cmd[1] := vecU_Prev[1] + vecDeltaU[1];
vecU_Cmd[2] := vecU_Prev[2] + vecDeltaU[2];
vecU_Cmd[3] := vecU_Prev[3] + vecDeltaU[3];

(* Enforce hard physical plant saturation boundaries *)
IF vecU_Cmd[1] > c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A THEN
    vecU_Cmd[1] := c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A;
ELSIF vecU_Cmd[1] <-c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A THEN
    vecU_Cmd[1] :=-c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A;
END_IF;

IF vecU_Cmd[2] > c_rMaxAllowableLaserPower_Watts THEN
    vecU_Cmd[2] := c_rMaxAllowableLaserPower_Watts;
ELSIF vecU_Cmd[2] < 0.0 THEN
    vecU_Cmd[2] := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF vecU_Cmd[3] > 100.0 THEN
    vecU_Cmd[3] := 100.0;
ELSIF vecU_Cmd[3] < 0.0 THEN
    vecU_Cmd[3] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Store historical commands for next cycle *)
vecU_Prev[1] := vecU_Cmd[1];
vecU_Prev[2] := vecU_Cmd[2];
vecU_Prev[3] := vecU_Cmd[3];

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 SUB-MICRORADIAN MULTI-AXIS PIEZOELECTRIC CO-PLANARITY LEVELING LOOP                   *)
(* Dual-axis PI regulator driving Theta-X and Theta-Y leveling actuators to 0.0 urad        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF (iState >= 50) AND (iState <= 100) THEN
    (* Axis X tilt error and integration *)
    rTmpA := 0.0 - rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad;
    rPiezoTiltX_Integral := rPiezoTiltX_Integral + (rTmpA * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 12.5);
    IF rPiezoTiltX_Integral > 250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltX_Integral := 250.0; ELSIF rPiezoTiltX_Integral <-250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltX_Integral :=-250.0; END_IF;
    rPiezoTiltXCmd_urad := (rTmpA * 1.85) + rPiezoTiltX_Integral;
    
    (* Axis Y tilt error and integration *)
    rTmpB := 0.0 - rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad;
    rPiezoTiltY_Integral := rPiezoTiltY_Integral + (rTmpB * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 12.5);
    IF rPiezoTiltY_Integral > 250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltY_Integral := 250.0; ELSIF rPiezoTiltY_Integral <-250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltY_Integral :=-250.0; END_IF;
    rPiezoTiltYCmd_urad := (rTmpB * 1.85) + rPiezoTiltY_Integral;
ELSE
    rPiezoTiltX_Integral := 0.0;
    rPiezoTiltY_Integral := 0.0;
    rPiezoTiltXCmd_urad := 0.0;
    rPiezoTiltYCmd_urad := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTI-STAGE THERMO-COMPRESSION BONDING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF iState <> iPreviousState THEN
    rStateTimerAccum_Sec := 0.0; (* Reset dwell time upon state entry *)
    iPreviousState := iState;
ELSE
    rStateTimerAccum_Sec := rStateTimerAccum_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: POWER-ON SELF TEST & HARDWARE VALIDATION (POST) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
        bBondCycleComplete := FALSE;
        bTouchDownDetected := FALSE;
        bLaserEmissionActive := FALSE;
        bUltrasonicEmissionActive := FALSE;
        bSolderLiquefactionTriggered := FALSE;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rFormingGasPurgeCmd_sccm := 0.0;
        rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2 := 0.0;
        rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm := 0.0;
        
        (* Verify POST health criteria *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.50) AND bEnableSystem AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
            IF bForce_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bPos_ChA_Healthy THEN
                iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby Ready *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: STANDBY & SYSTEM READY IDLE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rFormingGasPurgeCmd_sccm := 250.0; (* Standby trickle shroud purge *)
        
        IF bStartBondCycle AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
            bBondCycleComplete := FALSE;
            bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
            rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iState := 20; (* Proceed to Chiplet Pick & Alignment *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: CHIPLET VACUUM ACQUISITION & OPTICAL ALIGNMENT DWELL *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Verify vacuum collet pickup and sub-micron vision offsets *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.150) THEN
            IF (ABS(rVisionOffsetX_um) < 0.250) AND (ABS(rVisionOffsetY_um) < 0.250) AND (ABS(rVisionOffsetTheta_mrad) < 0.050) THEN
                rTraj_TargetPos_nm := 250000.0; (* 250 um approach datum above substrate *)
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to Rapid Z Approach *)
            ELSIF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 2.0 THEN
                bSystemTrip := TRUE;
                dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Vision Alignment Timeout *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: HIGH-SPEED Z-DESCENT APPROACH PROFILE (POSITION CONTROL) *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* High-speed downward trajectory generation: S-curve profile *)
        IF rTraj_CurrentPos_nm < rTraj_TargetPos_nm THEN
            rTraj_CurrentPos_nm := rTraj_CurrentPos_nm + (2500000.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds); (* 2.5 mm/s approach speed *)
        ELSE
            rTraj_CurrentPos_nm := rTraj_TargetPos_nm;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Position Servo closed loop using voice coil *)
        rTmpA := rTraj_CurrentPos_nm - rVotedZPosition_nm;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := (rTmpA * 0.00018) - (vecX_Hat[2] * 0.000025);
        
        (* Transition when approach datum reached *)
        IF ABS(rVotedZPosition_nm - rTraj_TargetPos_nm) < 1500.0 THEN
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Soft-Touch Search *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: SOFT-TOUCH SEARCH & MICRO-FORCE TOUCHDOWN TRANSITION (0.10 N) *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Slow search velocity descent: 15.0 um/s *)
        rTraj_CurrentPos_nm := rTraj_CurrentPos_nm + (15000.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        rTmpA := rTraj_CurrentPos_nm - rVotedZPosition_nm;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := (rTmpA * 0.00012) - (vecX_Hat[2] * 0.000030);
        
        (* Soft-Touch Contact Detection: Threshold 0.10 N with encoder deceleration spike *)
        IF (rVotedBondForce_N >= 0.10) OR (vecX_Hat[3] >= 0.10) THEN
            bTouchDownDetected := TRUE;
            rTouchDownPosLatch_nm := rVotedZPosition_nm;
            rBaselineAcousticMag := rGoertzel_Mag; (* Capture solid contact acoustic baseline *)
            rTraj_TargetForce_N := rInitialContactForce_N; (* Ramp to initial leveling force 2.5 N *)
            iState := 50; (* Proceed to Tilt Leveling *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 3.0 THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Soft-Touch Search Distance Exceeded *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: MULTI-AXIS TILT LEVELING & INITIAL ELASTIC CO-PLANAR SQUEEZE (2.5 N TO 15.0 N) *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Ramp force to 15.0 N for co-planarity alignment *)
        IF rTraj_TargetForce_N < 15.0 THEN
            rTraj_TargetForce_N := rTraj_TargetForce_N + (50.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;
        
        (* Force Loop Execution via MPC / PID *)
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := vecU_Cmd[1];
        
        (* Check if angular tilt co-planarity satisfied (< 10.0 urad) *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.080) AND (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad) < 10.0) AND (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad) < 10.0) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Vacuum Purge & Pre-Heating *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 1.5 THEN
            (* Proceed with warning if tilt slightly degraded *)
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Co-planarity Leveling Dwell Timeout *)
            iState := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: MICRO-GAP VACUUM CHAMBER FORMING GAS PURGE & PRE-HEATING (150 deg C) *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rFormingGasPurgeCmd_sccm := 1500.0; (* High-flow forming gas purge *)
        
        (* Ramp preheat temperature to 150 deg C *)
        rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC := rPreheatTemp_DegC;
        rTraj_TargetForce_N := 25.0;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := vecU_Cmd[1];
        
        (* Modulate laser power for pre-heat soak *)
        IF rVotedJointTemp_DegC < rPreheatTemp_DegC THEN
            bLaserEmissionActive := TRUE;
            rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 180.0;
        ELSE
            rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 45.0; (* Soak maintenance power *)
        END_IF;
        
        (* Verify vacuum and soak temperature stability *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.150) AND (rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar <= (rTargetVacuumLevel_mbar * 2.0)) AND (rVotedJointTemp_DegC >= (rPreheatTemp_DegC - 5.0)) THEN
            iState := 70; (* Trigger Ultra-Rapid Laser Reflow *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 3.0 THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Vacuum / Preheat Timeout Trip *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: ULTRA-RAPID LASER THERMAL REFLOW (450 deg C / s) & DYNAMIC FORCE PROFILE (500 N) *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        bLaserEmissionActive := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Rapid thermal ramp generation: 450.0 deg C / s up to peak setpoint *)
        IF rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC < rTargetPeakTemp_DegC THEN
            rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC := rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC + (rTargetLaserRamp_DegC_Per_Sec * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC := rTargetPeakTemp_DegC;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Dynamic force profile: As temperature approaches liquidus, ramp force to peak *)
        IF rVotedJointTemp_DegC >= c_rSAC305MeltingPoint_DegC THEN
            IF rTraj_TargetForce_N < rTargetPeakForce_N THEN
                rTraj_TargetForce_N := rTraj_TargetForce_N + (850.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds); (* 850 N/s squeeze ramp *)
            ELSE
                rTraj_TargetForce_N := rTargetPeakForce_N;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Apply Model Predictive Control outputs *)
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := vecU_Cmd[1];
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := vecU_Cmd[2];
        
        (* Transition to Ultrasonic Scrub when solder liquefies or peak temp reached *)
        IF (rVotedJointTemp_DegC >= (rTargetPeakTemp_DegC - 3.0)) OR bSolderLiquefactionTriggered THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Ultrasonic Scrub & IMC Dwell *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.850 THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Laser Heating Ramp Stalled *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: IN-SITU ULTRASONIC BOND SIGNATURE MONITORING & IMC METALLURGY DWELL *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        bLaserEmissionActive := TRUE;
        bUltrasonicEmissionActive := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Maintain thermal soak and peak compression force *)
        rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC := rTargetPeakTemp_DegC;
        rTraj_TargetForce_N := rTargetPeakForce_N;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := vecU_Cmd[1];
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := vecU_Cmd[2];
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := rUltrasonicPowerSetpoint_Pct;
        
        (* Check ultrasonic burst duration and IMC growth achievement *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccum_Sec >= (rUltrasonicDuration_ms * 0.001)) THEN
            bUltrasonicEmissionActive := FALSE;
            rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
            bLaserEmissionActive := FALSE;
            rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
            iState := 90; (* Proceed to Quench Solidification *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CRYOGENIC / CHILLED GAS QUENCH & SOLIDIFICATION HOLD *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        bLaserEmissionActive := FALSE;
        bUltrasonicEmissionActive := FALSE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Activate chilled quench gas nozzle (-250 deg C / s cooling rate) *)
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 100.0;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        
        (* Maintain freeze hold force during crystallization *)
        rTraj_TargetForce_N := rTargetPeakForce_N * 0.75; (* 75% freeze hold force *)
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := vecU_Cmd[1];
        
        (* Transition once solidified below 160 deg C *)
        IF (rVotedJointTemp_DegC <= 160.0) AND (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.350) THEN
            rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
            iState := 100; (* Proceed to Post-Bond Metrology Scan *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 2.5 THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Thermal Quench Timeout Trip *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: POST-BOND BONDLINE THICKNESS & CO-PLANARITY METROLOGY SCAN *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := TRUE;
        rCycleTotalTimer_Sec := rCycleTotalTimer_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        
        (* Smoothly ramp compressive force down to zero *)
        IF rTraj_TargetForce_N > 1.0 THEN
            rTraj_TargetForce_N := rTraj_TargetForce_N - (350.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rTraj_TargetForce_N := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := vecU_Cmd[1];
        
        (* Evaluate final quality criteria *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.100) THEN
            IF rBondQualityIndex < 0.60 THEN
                dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Bond Quality Index Below Spec *)
            END_IF;
            IF (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm < 250.0) OR (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm > 1400.0) THEN
                dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: IMC Thickness Violation *)
            END_IF;
            iState := 110; (* Transition to Release & Retract *)
        END_IF;

    110: (* STATE 110: COLLET RELEASE, VACUUM BLOW-OFF & HIGH-ACCELERATION RETRACT *)
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A :=-1.25; (* Controlled negative lift current *)
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        
        (* Once clear of substrate (> 1000 um), complete cycle *)
        IF (rVotedZPosition_nm < (rTouchDownPosLatch_nm - 1000000.0)) OR (rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.400) THEN
            bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
            bBondCycleComplete := TRUE;
            bTouchDownDetected := FALSE;
            rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
            iState := 10; (* Return to Standby Ready *)
        END_IF;

    200: (* STATE 200: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION / RECOVERY MODE *)
        bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
        bDegradedControlMode := TRUE;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        IF bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    900: (* STATE 900: EMERGENCY SAFETY ABORT & FAILSAFE RETRACT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
        bLaserEmissionActive := FALSE;
        bUltrasonicEmissionActive := FALSE;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A :=-3.50; (* Emergency retract current to lift collet away *)
        
        IF rStateTimerAccum_Sec > 0.500 THEN
            rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
            iState := 999; (* Enter Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE 999: LOCKOUT / POST-TRIP MAINTENANCE INSPECTION DWELL *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        
        IF bAcknowledgeFault AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
            iState := 0; (* Return to POST *)
        END_IF;
END_CASE;
